approval.reason: Bootstrap r1 baseline for Galaxy S22 Ultra en-US. Full Run and Candidate v2 validation passed with clean provenance. Water Leak and Motion Sensor battery speech findings were manually verified as false positives caused by TTS observation limitations. The Home Monitor Settings role-only announcement is retained as an environment-scoped accepted known limitation. Clothing Care traversal diagnostics are acknowledged separately as non-blocking automation-engine diagnostics.

automation_acknowledgments.comment: Known traversal termination/recovery diagnostic on the Clothing Care screen. Preserved in the approval audit and accepted as non-blocking for this bootstrap baseline; not classified as an independent application accessibility limitation.

known_limitation_snapshot.description: Home Monitor Settings control exposes no meaningful accessible name and TalkBack announces only the role "Button".
known_limitation_snapshot.impact: User cannot identify button purpose by speech alone.

structured_limitations.comment: Manually verified on the target device. TalkBack announces "One hundred percent". The empty automated speech result is caused by the current TTS observation limitation.
